description: Faraday MHD generator: P = sigma * u^2 * B^2 * K*(1-K) * V_channel

unit.name: Open-cycle MHD generator (coal/gas, K2CO3 seeded plasma)
unit.source: Rosa, R.J. (1987) Magnetohydrodynamic Energy Conversion. McGraw-Hill; Way, S. et al. (1979) AIAA

K_load.note: Load factor K = V_load / EMF; K=0.5 max power point

channel_width.note: MHD channel width (perpendicular to B and u)

eta_plant.note: Combined plant efficiency MHD + bottoming cycle ~50%
